description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractInstallerController' which provides the base for handling installer-related HTTP requests in the OrangeHRM application. It manages responses, checks installation status, and enforces response type constraints.

classes.name: AbstractInstallerController
classes.description: An abstract controller base class responsible for handling installer request flows, response management, and installation status checks.

methods.name: getNewResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Response object.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the current response object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response object, validating that it's an instance of Response or RedirectResponse or null.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main request handler that checks if the application is installed and handles the request accordingly, returning a response.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to handle specific request logic.
